title: 노른자 터뜨리는 기술

cuts.scene: The wife rabbit, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, holding a broken egg, looks frustrated in a kitchen.
The husband sloth, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, stands next to the wife, observing with a calm expression.

cuts.line: 이건 뭐야, 언제 샀어, 왜 말 안 했어
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, picks up the real product from the counter, surprised.

cuts.line: 어? 왜 돼? 왜 잘 돼?
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, successfully uses the real product, eyes wide in disbelief.
The husband sloth, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, looks at the wife with a knowing, slightly amused expression.
The guide character, standing in the scene with a product card and a judgment stamp, speaks clearly. The real product is displayed.

cuts.line: 근데 저번에 산 그거, 거품기는 어디 갔지
cuts.scene: The wife rabbit, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, glances towards a closed drawer, looking for another item.
The husband sloth, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, is in the kitchen, casually blocking access to a drawer.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
